visual_identity.motion_language: slow biological pulses that accelerate into branching growth; ripple, divide, mutate, bloom

states.description: A dim zonot pool breathes with faint green-blue bioluminescence; small cytoplast particles drift in parallax.
Cells divide softly around the cursor; nearby filaments connect into a temporary lattice.
A growth spiral rises from the card edge; +1/+1 counter motes orbit once before settling into the frame.
The frame expands by mitosis: nodes split, reconnect, and brighten as the placement confidence increases.
A deepwater ripple wipes in from lower left; the text appears as if revealed by moving lab light.
The lattice folds back into a single cytoplast bead that sinks beneath the surface.

placement_card.background: radial deepwater gradient with translucent cellular overlays
placement_card.border: organic rounded membrane, not hard geometry
placement_card.accent: small animated cytoplast nodes at section dividers
placement_card.microcopy_reveal: line-by-line like a research specimen being annotated

matrix_row.hover: subtle pulse on structural_axis and narrative_tags
matrix_row.selected: counter mote travels from card_name to vox_mana_read
matrix_row.filter_active: branches prune away nonmatching rows with a soft dissolve

taxonomy_panel.category_icon_style: simple biological glyphs: helix, fin, shell, eye, spiral, root
taxonomy_panel.section_transition: zonot accordion: panel opens like a membrane expanding

animation_tokens.simic_zonot_ripple: blurred radial ring expanding 0 to 64px while fading
animation_tokens.simic_growth_branch: stroke-dashoffset draw with slight curve jitter
animation_tokens.simic_mitosis_split: one dot divides into two with damped spring separation
animation_tokens.simic_adapt_flash: brief cyan edge-light after a counter/growth event

accessibility.reduced_motion: replace mitosis and ripple motion with static glow and 150ms opacity transitions
accessibility.contrast_note: ensure cyan text is never placed directly on bright green glow; keep body copy on dark deepwater base
accessibility.semantic_note: do not rely on motion alone to show adapt/evolve state; include text badges
